what_ran: zero-training Himawari-9 satellite context served beside a persistence forecast
claim_level: descriptive satellite context only; NOT fused inference, NOT a validated satellite arm, NOT a warning lead time

pre_existing_failures.reason: XGBoostPolicyError not raised; surfaces only because xgboost 3.4.1 is installed locally
portable-export parity 1.394 vs 1e-5 tolerance; the already-recorded XGBoost parity defect that is why XGBoost is marked BLOCKED

tests.pre_existing_evidence: Neither failing module references satellite_context (grep count 0), and no file under prototype/ was modified - only three new files were added.

noaa_download.note: full SHA-256 values are in satellite_context.json; the raw .bz2 objects stay in a scratchpad cache and are not in git or evidence

satpy_decode.physical_qc_significance: Satpy removed zero pixels from the [180,330] K physical range. benchmarks/halo/hsd.py produced 4.49 % of pixels below 180 K on this product, which is direct evidence for excluding the unvalidated reader from anything that reaches a dashboard.

timing_contract.note: Frame age is a measured lag. It is not a warning lead time in either direction.

forecast.non_fusion_proof: The forecast is 32.675 degC in all four states: context present, context absent, context malformed, context stale. Identical output across those states is the operative proof that no satellite value enters the prediction.

degradation_verified.degraded_reason: satellite context is unreadable: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 2 (char 1)
frame is stale: 45.0 min old exceeds the 10 min freshness limit

board.apparent_temperature_parity: The board has no NumPy, so it runs the stdlib mirror. It produced 32.675 degC, identical to the laptop's NumPy-backed target.apparent_temperature_c.

forbidden_claims_not_made: no satellite improvement to the forecast
remaining_blockers: The satellite arm remains unvalidated for prediction: no fused model exists, and the P1 gate in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-15-halo-safeshift-technical-design.md section 10 has not been attempted.
Only one historical frame was extracted, so delta30/delta60/trend90 are absent by design rather than computed.
Publication lag is an assumption (20 min core, 0/10/20/30 sensitivity), not a measurement of this object's real availability.
The 25 km ROI holds 339 pixels because AHI's 2 km sampling applies at the sub-satellite point, not over Vietnam; no per-pixel footprint was computed.
Two pre-existing XGBoost test failures remain unfixed (out of scope).
